temperatures.name: Freezing
temperatures.desc: Bone-chilling frost; water freezes solid; hypothermia risk without warm furs.

temperatures.name: Cold & Crisp
temperatures.desc: Brisk autumn chill; breath mists in the air; pleasant for fast marching.

temperatures.name: Mild & Temperate
temperatures.desc: Gentle, comfortable weather ideal for cross-country travel.

temperatures.name: Warm & Humid
temperatures.desc: Heavy warmth; pack beasts tire quickly; requires frequent hydration.

temperatures.name: Sweltering Heat
temperatures.desc: Blistering scorching sun; mirages on the horizon; heat exhaustion risk.

conditions.name: Clear Blue Skies
conditions.desc: Unobscured sun and unlimited visibility to the horizon.

conditions.name: Scattered Clouds
conditions.desc: Gentle, rolling cumulus clouds offering intermittent shade.

conditions.name: Overcast & Gloomy
conditions.desc: Lead-grey cloud blanket muting light and casting dreary shadows.

conditions.name: Light Rain / Drizzle
conditions.desc: Steady, damp drizzle soaking clothes and softening the soil.
conditions.travel_impact: Normal pace; campsite prep requires dry timber.

conditions.name: Heavy Downpour
conditions.desc: Torrents of blinding rain churning roads into thick mud.
conditions.travel_impact: Movement halved; small brooks swell into torrents.

conditions.name: Raging Thunderstorm
conditions.desc: Crashing lightning, deafening thunderclaps, and howling squalls.
conditions.travel_impact: Travel dangerous; open terrain risks lightning strikes.

conditions.name: Blinding Snow / Sleet
conditions.travel_impact: Parties must seek shelter or become hopelessly lost.

winds.name: Calm Air
winds.desc: Still, motionless leaves and smoke rising straight up.

winds.name: Gentle Breeze
winds.desc: Pleasant rustling in the treetops, carrying scents.

winds.name: Stiff Wind
winds.desc: Buffeting gusts that tear at cloaks and rattle branches.

winds.name: Howling Gale
winds.desc: Violent squalls that snap boughs and whip dust into eyes.
